title: Reconciliation tool overwrites inputs through symlink or hardlink, and overwrites any existing non-input file
evidence: Sandbox copy only: --out given as a symlink to cases_53.jsonl, and as a hardlink to identity_resolution.csv, both exit 0 and replace the input with the report. --out pointing at an existing records_658.jsonl copy (not in the input list) is overwritten silently. Guard compares abspath strings only. Claims 'never overwrites' and 'refuses an output path that is one of its inputs' are therefore not true as stated. No test covers these cases.
consequence: With --repo, a mistyped or linked --out can destroy an immutable original (records_658.jsonl is never in the guarded set). Violates the project invariant that originals are never written.
reproduction: In a temp copy: ln -s c/cases_53.jsonl link.csv; python reconcile_judgments.py --incoming b.jsonl --cases c/cases_53.jsonl ... --out link.csv; head -c 80 c/cases_53.jsonl
required_correction: Compare with os.path.realpath and os.path.samefile; refuse any existing --out (open with mode 'x'); refuse any --out under the --repo root or under curated_originals; add tests for symlink, hardlink, existing file and in-repo path.

title: Failing-signature file is used as commencement evidence in the matrix without a caveat
evidence: The pack recommends that T1-20 (S.R.O. 17(E)/2019, sha 138c1da0) be non-primary and not approved because its CMS signature fails. D-AMC-AR-034 takes commencement_date_evidenced 2019-12-28 from the same file with no mention of the signature result. I confirmed the failure independently: openssl cms -verify -noverify fails at SignerInfo verify; manual RSA public-key operation on the signature with the embedded certificate does not yield a PKCS#1 block; SHA-256 of the signed byte range equals the messageDigest attribute.
consequence: Two workstreams give the same file different standing. The page text itself reads 'come into force on the date of their publication' (I read p.2), so the date is as printed, but the copy's weakness is not carried into the matrix.
reproduction: extract /ByteRange and /Contents; openssl cms -verify -inform DER -content <signed bytes> -noverify -binary
required_correction: Add the signature limitation to D-AMC-AR-034 and D-SSM-043 (and to dependent chain rows r.15B, r.16A).
